title: Detailed envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Envelope body -->
  <rect x='12' y='25' width='76' height='52' rx='5' fill='#f4e6b8' stroke='#e0c870' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Envelope inner shadow at top -->
  <rect x='12' y='25' width='76' height='8' rx='5' fill='#e8d48a'/>
  <!-- Flap (triangle pointing down) -->
  <polygon points='12,25 50,55 88,25' fill='#f8efc8' stroke='#e0c870' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Flap inner fold lines -->
  <line x1='12' y1='25' x2='50' y2='55' stroke='#dcb850' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='88' y1='25' x2='50' y2='55' stroke='#dcb850' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Bottom fold lines -->
  <line x1='12' y1='77' x2='35' y2='55' stroke='#e0c870' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='88' y1='77' x2='65' y2='55' stroke='#e0c870' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Wax seal -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='8' fill='#e05050' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='5' fill='#c03030'/>
  <!-- Seal highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='53' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#ff9090' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Stamp -->
  <rect x='67' y='31' width='15' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#88cc55' stroke='#a8e070' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Stamp perforated edge -->
  <line x1='67' y1='31' x2='82' y2='31' stroke='#e8f8d0' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='1.5,1.5'/>
  <line x1='67' y1='49' x2='82' y2='49' stroke='#e8f8d0' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='1.5,1.5'/>
  <line x1='67' y1='31' x2='67' y2='49' stroke='#e8f8d0' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='1.5,1.5'/>
  <line x1='82' y1='31' x2='82' y2='49' stroke='#e8f8d0' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='1.5,1.5'/>
  <!-- Stamp design: tiny flower -->
  <circle cx='74.5' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='74.5' cy='38' r='1' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <circle cx='74.5' cy='35.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='74.5' cy='40.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='38' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='38' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Address lines -->
  <line x1='22' y1='62' x2='45' y2='62' stroke='#c0a850' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='67' x2='40' y2='67' stroke='#c0a850' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='72' x2='37' y2='72' stroke='#c0a850' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
